author: J. Kim Murphy
title: Box Office: Final Destination at Franchise-Best, Hurry Up Tomorrow Slow - Variety
description: 'Final Destination Bloodlines' logged a series-high opening day, while the Weeknd's 'Hurry Up Tomorrow' is slowing down for a slim opening.
content_summary: Final Destination Bloodlines, the sixth installment in the horror franchise, achieved a franchise-best opening day with $21 million across 3,523 locations. The film benefits from premium formats, positive critical reception, and strong audience engagement, positioning it well for box office success. Conversely, The Weeknd's psychological thriller Hurry Up Tomorrow underperformed with $2.33 million opening, hindered by mixed reviews and limited appeal. Other films like Sinners, Thunderbolts continue steady earnings, while A Minecraft Movie and The Accountant 2 maintain theatrical presence.

author: Chris Gardner
title: Angelina Jolie Delivers Humanitarian Message at Chopard Dinner in Cannes - The Hollywood Reporter
description: The Oscar winner turned up at Carlton Beach to honor rising stars Marie Colomb and Finn Bennett at Chopard's annual gala, attended by festival officials and high-profile talent.
content_summary: Angelina Jolie, serving as Chopard Godmother, presided over the annual gala honoring emerging actors Marie Colomb and Finn Bennett during Cannes 2025. She emphasized international cinema's power to foster empathy and highlighted artists lost amid conflicts. The event gathered prominent figures like Quentin Tarantino and Halle Berry, underscoring the festival's blend of glamour and humanitarian advocacy.

author: Nancy Dillon, Cheyenne Roundtree
title: Sean Combs Trial: Dawn Richard Tells Jury She Witnessed Violent Assault on Cassie - Rolling Stone
description: Dawn Richard testified at Sean Combs' criminal trial Friday after Cassie Ventura finished four days on the witness stand.
content_summary: Dawn Richard, former Danity Kane singer, testified at Sean Combs' trial recounting a violent 2009 assault on Cassie Ventura. Richard described Combs' aggressive behavior including attempts to hit Ventura with a skillet, resulting in physical harm. Her testimony supports prosecution claims of abuse and intimidation within Combs’ alleged criminal enterprise. Combs denies all charges.

author: Alex Ritman
title: Harris Dickinson's 'Urchin' Gets 5-Minute Cannes Standing Ovation - Variety
description: 'Triangle and Sadness' and 'Babygirl' star Harris Dickinson has delighted the Cannes crowd with his feature directorial debut 'Urchin'
content_summary: Harris Dickinson's directorial debut Urchin, depicting homelessness and mental health struggles in London, premiered at Cannes to a 5-minute standing ovation. The film stars Frank Dillane as a former prisoner trying to escape self-destructive patterns. This acclaimed debut marks Dickinson's promising transition from actor to filmmaker.

author: Amanda Krause
title: 11 daring dresses that might be banned at the Cannes Film Festival if worn today - Business Insider
description: The Cannes Film Festival has always featured red carpets with daring fashion. Thanks to a new dress code, that's changing this year.
content_summary: The 2025 Cannes Film Festival introduced a stricter dress code banning nudity and excessive dress trains, altering the iconic red carpet fashion. Notable past gowns featuring sheer fabrics, plunging necklines, and voluminous trains by stars like Bella Hadid and Kendall Jenner would no longer comply. This policy reflects a shift towards more modest and practical red carpet attire while marking an end to some of Cannes’ most daring styles.
